look: Thornshade Prowler, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Thorncrystal Stalkers family: larger shadowy panther accompanied by a translucent reflection of itself. Family anatomy: lean panther-like hunting cats with a ridge of crystal thorns along the back and a faint afterimage. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are teal thorn crystal. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Wind: teal, pale green and silver accents, clear spiralling leaves, gust lines and floating feathers
